name: FutaQuest
source: A fresh start in a new city takes an unexpected turn when strange events lead you into another world. With little experience and a tendency to trust too easily, you’ll discover that the women you meet have plans of their own.
translation: 原本打算在陌生城市开启全新生活，却因一连串离奇事件意外踏入了异世界。涉世未深又过于轻信他人的你很快就会发现，自己邂逅的那些女人们全都各怀鬼胎。
